text:
maria: quick follow-up from last night's postmortem — want to lock owners/timeline for remediation and SLO updates. tl;dr p99 spikes during bursty traffic and autoscale lagged.
aj: saw that, thanks. can we list concrete action items here?
leo: main pattern is concurrent-kv-cache-warm causing 300-500ms extra on first few requests per session. recurring around 02:00 UTC when backups start.
samir: current errorbudget burn this week is 12% after the incident (weekly window). we hit p99=1.1s at peak, p95=220ms.
sre-bot: incident-2912345678 created: https://incidents.redwood/2912345678 — added to "latency-regressions" queue. :white_check_mark:
maria: proposed SLO adjustments (temp) for generator route /v1/generate to reduce noise while we fix root cause: p95 <= 220ms (was 150ms), p99 <= 1.2s (was 800ms). open to pushback.
aj: I'd prefer not to loosen p95 too much. alternative: keep p95 and add a transient elevated-threshold window for 02:00-03:30 UTC where we tolerate higher p99.
leo: implementation plan: 1) dashboard update with split by session cold/warm (AJ) 2) autoscale tweak to pre-warm pools before backup window (Leo) 3) prefix KV warm cache on rollover (Samir) 4) add regression alert for small-batch cold starts (Maria).
maria: assigning owners + deadlines: AJ - dashboard + alerts by Thu EOD; Leo - autoscale pre-warm PR and canary by next Tue; Samir - KV warm prototype by Mon, integration by next Wed; Maria - update runbook + SLO policy draft by Fri.
aj: noted. dashboard query I'll add (draft):
```
# latency split by cache state
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le, cache_state))
```
leo: autoscale change: will add pre-warm hook to pool-manager and test on staging. canary schedule: Wed 02:00 staging, Thu 02:00 prod (low traffic fallback).
samir: replay results in staging show 30% fewer p99 spikes with KV warm enabled. I'll attach logs to the incident.
ops-rotation: monitoring note — we'll hold off Pager for p99 until AJ's alert is live; keep Slack alerts for ops channel.
maria: do we agree on temporary SLO shift vs. time-window tolerance? vote with reactions pls. :thumbsup: = window tolerance, :thumbsdown: = global loosen
aj: :thumbsup: from me.
leo: :thumbsup:
samir: :thumbsup:
maria: great — proceeding with windowed tolerance approach. action owners as above. I'll update the incident with timeline and create a follow-up ticket for a permanent SLO review after fixes.
aj: one more: update dashboard to show error budget projection if current burn rate continues. that'll help product when we discuss SLA implications.
maria: good call, include that in AJ's checklist.
leo: blocking question — do we need a short-term capacity reservation for upcoming release next week? if yes we should escalate to infra sales lane.
maria: defer to infra+product — I'll ping infra-ownership and product-schedule after this thread.
sre-bot: action items added to incident checklist: AJ(dashboard), Leo(autoscale), Samir(kv-warm), Maria(runbook). deadlines recorded.
maria: thanks everyone. will post a one-pager for the exec sync tomorrow. if anything blocks owners please raise here. :eyes:
